title: Reserve shared quotas and resources for concurrent model workers
goal: Wire atomic admission reservations into parallel dispatch for provider/account/key/model request and token limits, paid spend, subprocesses and local CPU/RAM/VRAM capacity. Enforce per-mission and global concurrency, fairness, bounded queues and backpressure. Credentials sharing an account cannot multiply its quota; one exhausted account must not block unrelated working providers. Release/reconcile reservations on success, failure and cancellation; restart cannot silently oversubscribe. Injected-clock concurrency tests demonstrate bounded load, no double reservations and no starvation. Implement nonzero tests named parallel_model_admission_* in the production owning crate.
